stem.text: The reaction of bromine with warm $\text{NaOH(aq)}$ produces products with the same oxidation numbers, in the same ratios, as the reaction of chlorine with hot $\text{NaOH(aq)}$.
In one reaction between bromine and warm $\text{NaOH(aq)}$, $30.2\ \text{g}$ of a product containing sodium, bromine and oxygen is produced.
